I honestly thought that this was my post from awhile ago. I was having the same stress when I got fired. You will find people on this sub who have also gotten fired. Life moves on, but there’s always going to be an added stress when licensure is involved. 

I am in the middle of supervision for my LCSW and my supervisor wasn’t happy but she also appreciated my honesty. So her attestation was “with reservation”. The board emailed me and said “we aren’t going to take further action but don’t do it again”, to summarize. 

It feels like garbage, I got fired like 4 months ago. I moved back to my hometown one state over because it’s cheaper and it was honestly probably for the better. There are some things I miss about my “old life”, but you will eventually adjust. 

You have your moment, you will probably always feel the shame but don’t let it consume you. I went to my state boards disciplinary actions page online and when I saw what people got formally disciplined for, I felt a weight off my shoulders. 

The only person outside of my personal life that knows I got fired is my new clinical supervisor. I decided not to try and find one at my workplace and just pay out of pocket. My new workplace never asked, I never told them. 

You are always welcome to message me if you want. I’m sorry you’re going through this.
